newsitem.title: USA: Woman's search yields murder charge 25 years later.
newsitem.headline: Woman's search yields murder charge 25 years later.

text.p: A woman's search for the truth about the death of her baby brother 25 years ago ended this week with the indictment of her father on a murder charge, prosecutors said Friday.
Jan Barry Sandlin was indicted by a Dekalb County grand jury Thursday on charges of murder, aggravated assault and cruelty to children for the 1971 death of Matthew Stephen Golder.

Tracy Golder, who had been told that she killed her four- month-old brother by throwing him out of a crib when she was almost two years old, began searching for public records concerning the death two years ago.
Her investigation led a medical examiner to review records of the 1971 death and conclude that the baby did not die from an accidental fall.
"There is no way that the injuries could have occurred as described," Lee Anne Magone of the Dekalb County district attorney's office said.
Prosecutors planned to extradite Sandlin from Florida, where he is in prison for armed robbery.
